realization.galaxolide: Preferred PW realization uses weighed undiluted 4XA13770; the viscous material is not pipetted. Existing Galaxolide 50% DEP may be used only with confirmed w/w basis, at 1.200 g instead of 0.600 g per 5 g product-equivalent master, introducing 0.600 g extra DEP; record the changed matrix.
realization.exaltolide: Preferred PW realization uses weighed undiluted 2XX00186. Confirmed 10% w/w DPG may supply the same product amount at 1.500 g instead of 0.150 g, introducing 1.350 g extra DPG; not a matrix-identical substitute.
realization.ambrox: Weigh 150 mg neat Ambrox Super in the full master; no fictitious liquid volume.

thirty_ml_finished.concentration: 15 g product-equivalent / 100 mL finished solution (w/v); NOT 15% w/w or v/v

realization.coumarin: Use 0.060 g owned/PW neat powder. Confirmed 10% w/w DPG may supply the same product amount with 0.600 g stock, introducing 0.540 g extra DPG; record the changed matrix.

candidates.question: Does cardamom remain central across a soft aromatic, tonka and cedar transition?
Does stronger ester-supported cardamom and less blue/camphor freshness better match the reference?
Does removing the entire detail block improve or weaken recognition and transition? This tests a block, not each ingredient separately.

Does macrocyclic cushion reduce laundry character without washing out cardamom? Use the same stock matrix policy; do not compare a diluted Exaltolide variant against neat-only lead as if carriers were identical.
Are dry woody edges masking the spice? This is a base-block intervention, not isolated proof of synergy.
No public quantities, chromatogram or version-matched blind data justify an exact literal reconstruction.

selection.rationale: Best first information-rich architecture hypothesis balancing the documented EDT anchors; not a validated sensory winner.

sources.claim: Original EDT: cardamom, cedar, coumarin; US page also describes iris/tonka. Ingredient declaration is presence information, never a quantitative formula.
Bergamot, cedar/lavender and vetiver support the aromatic ambery EDT; other flankers are distinct.

Composition/oxygenated-fraction work supports cineole/terpinyl-acetate/linalool-family chemistry in sampled cardamom oil. No aroma-intensity, YSL proportion or perfume synergy was inferred from the enzyme study.
Isochroman/polycyclic musk identity and clean body. IPM product is not the DEP stock used in this recipe.
Warm dry cedar/leather with musky undertones. No missing Trimofix/Vetiverol identity was silently merged into it.
Consult current applicable restriction records and supplier certificates, including coumarin and grouped rose ketones. No full-formula conformity claim is made.
50-name historical local transcription retained for questions/coverage only; not freshly authenticated, not a measured ingredient rank, not YSL formula quantities.

experiment.reference: Compare with your actual original EDT bottle; do not use an EDP/Le Parfum flanker
experiment.next: Lead vs minimal control; cardamom clear if recognizer weak; musk alternative if laundry drydown
